title: SpecsFirst gallery entry
description: One file per template: templates/<id>.yml. Only four fields are required; the rest is detected by the gallery. New fields are only ever added as optional.

url.description: Public HTTPS address of the git repository, on any forge.

description.description: One sentence: who it is for and what makes it different.

placement.description: Where the template's specs live. Defaults to standalone.

command.description: Optional: the exact install command to show, on one line. Shown as is; otherwise the gallery builds one from the detected copier.yml.

path.description: Optional: subfolder holding the template, if not at the repo root.

ref.description: Optional: tag or commit to show. Defaults to the default branch.

language.description: Optional: ISO 639-1 code. Defaults to en.
